name: annamalai-furniture
description: Annamalai Furniture — Premium Mobile-First Furniture Catalogue

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test:security: npm --prefix server run test:security && npm --prefix server run test:security-e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix server run test:e2e && npm --prefix server run test:admin-e2e
